name: ADP Workforce Now
description: ADP Workforce Now is ADP's HCM suite for small to midsized businesses, combining payroll, HR, time and attendance, talent management, and benefits administration on one platform, sold through packaged tiers that ADP prices per company via a custom quote.
best_for: Small to midsized employers wanting an established payroll provider's tax-compliance infrastructure bundled with HR, time, and talent management in one suite.
features: Continuous payroll calculation with automated tax compliance across jurisdictions
Embedded AI features including payroll anomaly detection, turnover trend analysis, and generative AI for job descriptions
Automated hiring, onboarding, and performance-review workflows with configurable business process automation
Real-time data sync across payroll, HR, time, and benefits modules
ADP Marketplace integrations with third-party HR, finance, and productivity tools
Employee self-service via the ADP Mobile Solutions app: pay statements, leave balances, time-off requests, and timesheets
Packaged tiers (e.g., Select, Plus) that bundle different combinations of payroll, HR, and talent features
pros: Backed by ADP's long-established payroll tax engine and compliance infrastructure
Talent management, time and attendance, and benefits administration are available within the same suite as payroll
ADP Marketplace offers a large library of pre-built third-party integrations
cons: No pricing is published on adp.com; every quote requires contacting ADP sales or calling in for a custom price

SOC 1/SOC 2 reports and ISO 27001/27701 certifications apply only to select ADP products, services, and locations rather than the entire company blanket-wide, so buyers should confirm coverage for the specific product they're evaluating

alternatives.name: Paychex Flex
